documents.title: New patient inquiry
documents.author: front desk
documents.body:
Caller Rodney Jacobs, 56, Easthampton. Wants to transfer care here; his old doctor's office is closing its panel to retirees on his plan and he would rather be somewhere he can reach someone. Takes blood pressure and cholesterol pills.
Booked new patient visit 9/22 at 9:00. Records release form emailed; he will sign and send back so we can request old records.

documents.title: New Patient Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
NEW PATIENT VISIT

56 yo man transferring care. Retired from the postal service a couple of years ago after a long career carrying a route. Feels well. No complaints today.

Hx:
- HTN for about 8 years, on HCTZ 25 mg every morning. Home cuff readings he remembers are mostly in the 130s.
- High cholesterol, on atorvastatin 20 mg for several years. No muscle aches.
- Takes a baby aspirin daily; started on his own years ago because of his father's heart history.
No surgeries.

Meds: HCTZ 25 mg qAM, atorvastatin 20 mg qHS, aspirin 81 mg daily.
Allergies: none known.

FHx: father had coronary disease young, around 52. Mother with high blood pressure. Brother on cholesterol medicine. A paternal uncle had gout.
SHx: married, lives in Easthampton. Never smoked. A beer or a glass of wine once or twice a week. Walks most mornings.

ROS: no chest pain, dyspnea, palpitations, edema, headaches or vision change. No joint complaints.

Exam: well appearing. Ht 178 cm. BP slightly above goal, see flowsheet. HEENT unremarkable. Neck supple, no bruit. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abd soft. Ext without edema, pulses 2+. Skin no rashes.
PHQ-2 0.

A/P
1. Hypertension - near goal on HCTZ. Continue. Recheck with labs.
2. Hyperlipidemia - continue atorvastatin 20. Fasting lipids today.
3. Health maintenance - colonoscopy per him about 3 years ago, normal; requesting old records to confirm. HCV and HIV screens today, he agrees. Flu shot given.
CMP, CBC, lipids drawn. F/u in about 6 months, sooner if needed.

documents.title: Your lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Rodney, your labs from Tuesday look fine. Kidney function and potassium are normal on the water pill, blood counts normal, and the hepatitis C and HIV screens were negative. LDL cholesterol is modestly above where I would like it but reasonable on your current dose; we will keep things as they are. Nice to meet you.

documents.author: MA
documents.body:
Records received from previous PCP office (covering 2014-2020), 41 pages, filed.
Abstracted for the chart:
- Problem list: hypertension, hyperlipidemia.
- Medications: hydrochlorothiazide 25 mg daily, atorvastatin 20 mg daily, aspirin 81 mg.
- Allergies: NKDA.
- Colonoscopy 06/2017: normal exam to the cecum, no polyps; next due 2027.
- Tdap given 03/2019.
Flagged for PCP review; PCP initialed.

documents.title: Follow-up Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
F/U HTN, lipids.
Doing well. Had both covid shots at the pharmacy. Walking 2-3 miles most mornings again now that the weather turned. No CP, SOB, lightheadedness. Taking meds daily, no side effects.
Exam: NAD. BP reviewed. Heart RRR, lungs clear, no edema.
A/P: HTN - office reading above goal, but his home log runs 130s/low 80s. Continue HCTZ, bring the cuff next time to compare. BMP today (on a diuretic). HLD - continue atorvastatin 20. Physical in the fall.

documents.title: Annual Physical Examination
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
ANNUAL EXAM - 57 M

Interval: no illnesses, no ED visits. Still walking most mornings. Wife keeps him on a decent diet.
Meds: HCTZ 25, atorvastatin 20, ASA 81. NKDA.
ROS negative incl. chest pain, exertional symptoms, GI bleeding, urinary symptoms.
FHx/SHx unchanged; never smoker, light alcohol.

Exam: BP/HR/wt per vitals. Eyes, ears normal. Neck no thyroid enlargement, no bruits. Heart RRR without murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, nontender, no masses. Ext no edema, DP 2+. Skin no concerning lesions. Normal gait.
PHQ-2: 0.

Assessment/plan
- Adult health exam. Colonoscopy 2017 normal, next 2027. Tdap 2019. Flu given today. First shingles vaccine today, second in 2-6 months.
- HTN: at goal-ish, continue.
- HLD: lipids today.
Return 6 months.

documents.body:
S: HTN/lipid check. No complaints. Home readings 130s/80s. Busy helping his brother clear out a house this spring.
Meds unchanged, adherent.
O: BP a little higher today. Heart regular, lungs clear, no edema.
A/P: HTN - borderline in office, home numbers ok. Keep HCTZ 25 for now, recheck at physical. Limit salt. HLD - stable on atorvastatin.
RTC fall for physical.

Physical, 58 yo M.
Since last: canceled July visit (family trip). Feels well. Walking daily. Has bivalent covid booster from pharmacy.
Meds: HCTZ 25 qd, atorva 20 qhs, ASA 81. NKDA.
ROS: denies CP, SOB, edema, joint swelling, GI or GU complaints.
Exam: vitals noted. HEENT nl. Neck supple. CV RRR, no m/r/g. Lungs CTA. Abd benign. Ext no edema. Skin: no lesions of concern on visible skin.
PHQ-2 0.
Plan: HTN controlled; HLD continue; flu today; CMP/CBC/lipids. Colon screening up to date (2017). Recheck spring.

documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Rodney - all your blood work from the physical is in the usual range for you. Cholesterol is about the same as last year. No changes. See you in the spring.
